tracks.title: Yachad
tracks.role: optional song (never under prayer screens or over learner speech)
tracks.lyrics: Come sit close, the candles glow / Friends and family, row by row / Bread is warm and hearts are wide / No one waiting left outside / Yachad, yachad, we sing as one / Shalom from dusk to rising sun / Lai lai lai, lai lai lai lai

tracks.title: Open Hands
tracks.role: optional song (never under prayer screens or over learner speech)
tracks.lyrics: In every hand a little flame / In every voice a gentle name / We open doors and build with care / We mend the world with what we share / Shalom, shalom, let peace begin / With open hands we welcome in

tracks.title: Gates of Morning A
tracks.role: optional song (never under prayer screens or over learner speech)
tracks.lyrics: Ah, ah, ah / Open the gates of morning light / Carry my voice beyond the night / Every breath a quiet prayer / Rising slowly through the air / Ana, ana, hear me sing / Shalom upon the dawn you bring
